chunks: They swore with their strongest oaths in the name of God that God would not raise the dead. On the contrary, it is a promise incumbent on Him, though most people do not know.
ai.seo_question: What is the Quranic response to those who deny resurrection?
ai.summary: In Surah An-Nahl, this verse highlights the cognitive dissonance of the Meccan disbelievers who swore by their strongest oaths that resurrection was impossible, yet God affirms it as a binding truth. Shia exegesis often links this 'promise' (wa'dan) to the concept of divine justice, emphasizing that resurrection is not merely a miracle but a necessary consequence of God's attribute of justice, which the majority of people fail to comprehend due to spiritual heedlessness.
